summary: Black-and-white Marathi classifieds strip: a black band of white line icons beside giant grey CLASSIFIEDS letters, categories marked by an icon box over a reverse label, ten narrow columns, and an agency directory in agate as the footer.

frame.masthead: Black band with round white line icons and the Marathi section name; CLASSIFIEDS in huge grey caps bleeding off the right.
frame.footer: Full-width run-in list of booking agencies by town, town names in bold italic.

headers.notes: Bordered box with a small line icon and the category, then the same word reversed out of a black bar.

units.notes: Bold lead, booking code in parentheses at the end.
WANTED in reverse, large serif caps, phone in a black bar.

type.look: Huge heavy grotesque caps in mid grey
Devanagari newspaper face with a Times-like Latin for English ads

notes: Same family as Eenadu (cl-015) but monochrome; a family can have a colour and a mono variant.
